sentences.text: The claim petition was filed seeking compensation of an amount of Rs.40,69,914/- for the death of the son of the claimants in the accident occurred on 18.05.2015.

The case of the claimants is that the deceased was aged about 22 years as on the date of the accident and working as a Manager /
Field Assistant in S.K.S Micro Finance Limited and drawing a monthly net salary of Rs.15,049/- as per Exhibit-P10.

The court below considering Exhibit-P10 had taken Rs.15,049/- as salary of the deceased and after deduction of 50% towards personal expenses and also by adding future prospects at 40% and applying the multiplier awarded an amount of Rs.29,25,720/- (Rs.15,049 - 50% = 7,525 + 40% x 12 x 18) towards loss of dependency.
NC: 2023:KHC:40773 3.

Learned counsel appearing for the insurance company submits that the accident is of the year 2015 and except marking Exhibit-P10, pay slip the claimants have not adduced any other evidence in support of the same.
Only basing on Exhibit-P10 the court below ought not to have considered the income of the deceased at Rs.15,049/- p.m., as salary which is on higher side.
He submits that even the interest granted at 9% is also on higher side.
It is submitted that the court below has awarded compensation amount contrary to the settled principles of law.
4. Learned counsel for the claimants submits that the court below has rightly considered Exhibit-P10 and granted compensation.

It is submitted that the amount that is granted is reasonable and no grounds are made out to interfere with the well-considered order passed by the court below.
NC: 2023:KHC:40773 5.
This Court finds force in the arguments of the learned counsel for the appellant - insurance company.
On behalf of claimants Exhibits-P1 to P14 are marked.
Exhibit- P1 to P9 are the police document, Exhibit-P10 is the pay slip.
On behalf of the claimants except examining PW-1 no other persons were examined.
When it is the case of the claimants that the deceased was earning Rs.15,049/- as net salary, they ought to have examined the concerned in support of the case.

Considering this and considering the fact that this is a case of death, this Court deems it appropriate to set-aside the award in MVC No.198/2015, dated 11.04.2018, passed by the Principal District Judge and MACT, Kodagu at Madikeri and remand the matter for fresh consideration in the interest of both the parties.
6. Accordingly, the appeal is Allowed and the matter is Remanded to the court below:
i) Without further notice the parties shall appear before the court below on 11.12.2023.

The court below shall also reconsider on the aspect of the interest.
On these two issues, the court below shall consider the evidence and pass appropriate orders within a period of five months from 11.12.2023.
